_comment: Manually reviewed claims the fabricated-claims audit may not find verbatim in research dumps. Each entry must include who verified it and why it's true. Match key: slug + field + matched_text.

allowed.reason: Hincapie Gran Fondo is a real multi-event series (Greenville, Chattanooga, Lehigh Valley, Fort Worth, Bentonville).
Rudi Altig won the 1966 UCI Road World Championship at the Nürburgring — documented cycling history, not a claim about this event.
Campagnolo (founded Vicenza, 1933) has equipped Tour, Giro, and Worlds winners across the Coppi/Merckx/Hinault eras — documented cycling history about the title sponsor, not a race claim.

Organizer page https://dbcevents.com/2026-roubaix/ titles the 2026 edition the Colorado Bicycle Racing Association State Road Race Championships, and Bicycle Colorado lists it as 'Boulder Roubaix - State Road Race Championships'; the dump records the organizer's wording (issue #689).
